payload.title: Plasmid Miniprep (Alkaline Lysis)
payload.description: Standard alkaline-lysis plasmid miniprep for purifying plasmid DNA from overnight E. coli cultures.

steps.description: Pellet 5 mL of overnight culture by centrifugation at 8000 x g for 3 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 250 uL P1 buffer by vortexing.
Add 250 uL P2 buffer and mix gently by inverting 6 times.
Add 350 uL P3 buffer and mix immediately; incubate on ice for 5 min.
Centrifuge at 13000 x g for 10 min and load the supernatant onto a spin column.
Wash the column once and elute in 50 uL elution buffer.
